scope: Authored deterministic scheduling examples, not timed IX execution. Unit-duration wide jobs and nonpreemptive diamond jobs have zero overhead and the stated workers.

state_vocabulary.dependency_ready: All declared dependencies satisfied; not a grant of capacity.
state_vocabulary.admitted: Capacity and applicable policy grant an execution slot.
state_vocabulary.completed: Observed terminal result for that attempt.

source_inspection_correction: The ix-pipeline execute comments advertise parallel std threads, but the inspected multi-node branch calls compute synchronously inside iterator.map().collect(), with no thread spawning. Do not infer actual parallelism or unbounded thread fan-out from those comments. No native Rust execution was performed.
